goal: Finish the S2 amendment deliverable of docs/specs/tracker-direct-publication.spec.md as a successor TaskIntent: make GitHub Initiative amendment use the direct write flow, verifying the approved baseline once at start and removing every post-write reread while leaving historical Children untouched.

acceptance.assertion: Implement S2 of docs/specs/tracker-direct-publication.spec.md in the existing amendment path, test-first. With the fake gh transport, an amendment verifies every bound Issue against its approved baseline once, from the start listing plus Issue-scoped relation reads, before any write; then performs one edit per changed pending brief, one create plus relations per new pending Child as in S1, and converges each pending Child's blocked_by set to the approved set. No repository listing follows the first write, no per-Child revalidation listing precedes a write and no closing recheck runs. Historical Children receive zero writes and keep their title, body, Sub-issue link and dependency relations. Omitted membership, baseline drift present at start and a stopped historical prerequisite still fail closed before any write with their existing failure class and one retry action. Rerunning the same approved amendment after a partial run creates no duplicate Issue and repeats no completed edit. The no-amendment publication behavior delivered by S1 and the mark-terminal path are unchanged. The Claude bundle is regenerated, the Planner amendment prose matches the behavior, the evidence fixture that hash-binds the Planner contract is re-hashed, and the carrier-gate test that asserts the Planner prose reflects the direct flow. No real remote writes in tests.
